selectionPolicy: lowest wave/order TODO whose dependencies are DONE

tasks.title: Verify developer environment
tasks.objective: Preflight reports a usable Node/Git setup and classifies pnpm/PostgreSQL/Ponytail availability without reinstalling tools that already exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight reports a usable Node/Git setup and classifies pnpm/PostgreSQL/Ponytail availability without reinstalling tools that already exist.

tasks.title: Enable pnpm and install workspace dependencies
tasks.objective: pnpm matching packageManager is available and workspace dependencies install successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm matching packageManager is available and workspace dependencies install successfully.

tasks.title: Connect local PostgreSQL and apply bootstrap schema
tasks.objective: DATABASE_URL points to an existing reachable PostgreSQL database; Prisma generate and initial migration succeed.
acceptanceCriteria: DATABASE_URL points to an existing reachable PostgreSQL database; Prisma generate and initial migration succeed.

tasks.title: Enable Ponytail for the active coding host
tasks.objective: Ponytail is installed/enabled for the developer coding agent, or the environment is explicitly marked host-unsupported with the repository minimalism rules active.
acceptanceCriteria: Ponytail is installed/enabled for the developer coding agent, or the environment is explicitly marked host-unsupported with the repository minimalism rules active.

tasks.title: Boot web and API health locally
tasks.objective: Next.js boot page and GET /health run locally with no business services required.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js boot page and GET /health run locally with no business services required.

tasks.title: Implement local authentication foundation
tasks.objective: Local credential authentication uses UserAccount passwordHash, active account status and secure password hashing without changing tenant membership data.
acceptanceCriteria: Local credential authentication uses UserAccount passwordHash, active account status and secure password hashing without changing tenant membership data.

tasks.title: Implement first-login password confirmation
tasks.objective: A PENDING account must choose keep-current or change-password before tenant/workspace selection; completion is audited.
acceptanceCriteria: A PENDING account must choose keep-current or change-password before tenant/workspace selection; completion is audited.

tasks.title: Implement tenant and workspace context selection
tasks.objective: Login continues through 0/1/many tenant and workspace selection rules and establishes active context.
acceptanceCriteria: Login continues through 0/1/many tenant and workspace selection rules and establishes active context.

tasks.title: Implement effective permission checks
tasks.objective: Backend authorization evaluates active tenant, active workspace, effective permission and scope instead of hard-coding workspace role names.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend authorization evaluates active tenant, active workspace, effective permission and scope instead of hard-coding workspace role names.

tasks.title: Implement Tenant Admin account provisioning
tasks.objective: Tenant Admin can create TenantPerson and provision/link UserAccount atomically without invitation flow or password disclosure in logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Admin can create TenantPerson and provision/link UserAccount atomically without invitation flow or password disclosure in logs.

tasks.title: Build role workspace shell and navigation
tasks.objective: Web shell initializes the approved UI stack (Tailwind/shadcn as needed), renders only active-workspace navigation, and supports context switching with permission reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Web shell initializes the approved UI stack (Tailwind/shadcn as needed), renders only active-workspace navigation, and supports context switching with permission reload.

tasks.title: Implement centers floors and rooms
tasks.objective: Tenant Admin can manage organization nodes, floors and rooms; rooms remain tenant/center scoped.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Admin can manage organization nodes, floors and rooms; rooms remain tenant/center scoped.

tasks.title: Implement people teacher student parent relationships
tasks.objective: Tenant people profiles support teacher type and active parent-child relationships required by later flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant people profiles support teacher type and active parent-child relationships required by later flows.

tasks.title: Implement subjects with local cover-image storage
tasks.objective: Tenant Admin can create/update/lifecycle subjects and upload optional cover images through MediaAsset using LOCAL storage keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Admin can create/update/lifecycle subjects and upload optional cover images through MediaAsset using LOCAL storage keys.

tasks.title: Implement configurable roles permissions and audit views
tasks.objective: Tenant Admin can manage baseline RBAC assignments safely and inspect append-only audit events with last-admin protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Admin can manage baseline RBAC assignments safely and inspect append-only audit events with last-admin protection.

tasks.title: Implement class CRUD and lifecycle
tasks.objective: Tenant Admin can create/update/start/complete classes under the documented lifecycle and validations.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant Admin can create/update/start/complete classes under the documented lifecycle and validations.

tasks.title: Implement teacher assignments
tasks.objective: Classes can have valid teacher assignments used as the teaching authorization/scheduling scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Classes can have valid teacher assignments used as the teaching authorization/scheduling scope.

tasks.title: Implement parent catalog and enrollment applications
tasks.objective: Parent Lớp học mới shows eligible classes/filters and supports one valid pending enrollment request per child/class.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent Lớp học mới shows eligible classes/filters and supports one valid pending enrollment request per child/class.

tasks.title: Implement child classes and pre-start withdrawal
tasks.objective: Parent Lớp học của con shows child-scoped application/enrollment state and supports documented pre-start withdrawal request lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent Lớp học của con shows child-scoped application/enrollment state and supports documented pre-start withdrawal request lifecycle.

tasks.title: Implement holidays and reusable time slots
tasks.objective: Tenant/center holidays and optional reusable time slots can be managed for scheduling input.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant/center holidays and optional reusable time slots can be managed for scheduling input.

tasks.title: Implement timetable rules conflicts and synchronous generation
tasks.objective: Timetable rules validate class/teacher/room overlap and synchronously generate/reconcile idempotent TeachingSessions while skipping holidays.
acceptanceCriteria: Timetable rules validate class/teacher/room overlap and synchronously generate/reconcile idempotent TeachingSessions while skipping holidays.

tasks.title: Implement TeachingSession ad-hoc and class progress
tasks.objective: TeachingSessions support documented types, ad-hoc creation, status/history protection and taught/planned progress including over-plan display data.
acceptanceCriteria: TeachingSessions support documented types, ad-hoc creation, status/history protection and taught/planned progress including over-plan display data.

tasks.title: Implement schedule screens for admin teacher student parent
tasks.objective: Schedule views load real TeachingSession data with role/relationship scoping and teacher schedule remains read-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Schedule views load real TeachingSession data with role/relationship scoping and teacher schedule remains read-only.

tasks.title: Implement teacher attendance
tasks.objective: Authorized teachers can mark attendance for assigned sessions; attendance-linked history is protected from automatic rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized teachers can mark attendance for assigned sessions; attendance-linked history is protected from automatic rewrite.

tasks.title: Implement student self check-in approval
tasks.objective: Student self check-in creates pending attendance and assigned teacher can approve/reject it.
acceptanceCriteria: Student self check-in creates pending attendance and assigned teacher can approve/reject it.

tasks.title: Implement class makeup
tasks.objective: A canceled/rescheduled original session remains historical and a linked CLASS_MAKEUP can be scheduled with conflict checks.
acceptanceCriteria: A canceled/rescheduled original session remains historical and a linked CLASS_MAKEUP can be scheduled with conflict checks.

tasks.title: Implement individual makeup
tasks.objective: An eligible absent student can join a compatible session or dedicated individual makeup without changing source enrollment/progress incorrectly.
acceptanceCriteria: An eligible absent student can join a compatible session or dedicated individual makeup without changing source enrollment/progress incorrectly.

tasks.title: Implement tuition accounts and payment recording
tasks.objective: Class tuition produces enrollment tuition state; permitted Tenant Admin can record payments/receipt references without accountant/cashier workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Class tuition produces enrollment tuition state; permitted Tenant Admin can record payments/receipt references without accountant/cashier workspace.

tasks.title: Implement teacher monthly workload
tasks.objective: Admin and allowed teacher views derive planned/completed sessions and planned/actual teaching minutes from TeachingSession data.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin and allowed teacher views derive planned/completed sessions and planned/actual teaching minutes from TeachingSession data.

tasks.title: Implement class and teacher ratings
tasks.objective: Class completion enables eligible student review; teacher ratings apply direct-over-derived precedence and documented default/derived behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Class completion enables eligible student review; teacher ratings apply direct-over-derived precedence and documented default/derived behavior.

tasks.title: Implement system-admin overview tenant and security surfaces
tasks.objective: SYSTEM_ADMIN global-only screens use real tenant/audit data and explicit tenant context where required.
acceptanceCriteria: SYSTEM_ADMIN global-only screens use real tenant/audit data and explicit tenant context where required.

tasks.title: Close prototype screen and dashboard coverage gaps
tasks.objective: Every surface in UI_SURFACE_MAP is backed by real baseline data/action or explicitly documented as out of approved scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Every surface in UI_SURFACE_MAP is backed by real baseline data/action or explicitly documented as out of approved scope.

tasks.title: Run focused end-to-end business smoke flows
tasks.objective: Playwright/API smoke covers login-first-login-context, admin class setup/start, parent enrollment, schedule/attendance and completion/rating happy paths without building a deep test suite.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright/API smoke covers login-first-login-context, admin class setup/start, parent enrollment, schedule/attendance and completion/rating happy paths without building a deep test suite.

tasks.title: Finalize baseline build documentation and handoff
tasks.objective: Type/build/schema/smoke validation is recorded and current progress/handoff accurately describe the runnable baseline and deferred integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Type/build/schema/smoke validation is recorded and current progress/handoff accurately describe the runnable baseline and deferred integrations.
